'''Jestat Vhool''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] and a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]]. He led three [[Kondo-class assault shuttle|''Kondo''-class assault shuttles]] to meet with [[Vestara Khai]] on [[Pydyr]]. Upon finding [[Abeloth]], Vhool was one of the many [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] overcome by her visions. Following her escape, he returned to his senses and stopped [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] from leaving. However, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[StealthX]] wing arrived soon after, attacking the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and letting the Skywalkers escape.

==Biography==
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] Jestat Vhool was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. He reached the rank of [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], and by [[44 ABY]] served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of three [[Kondo-class assault shuttle|''Kondo''-class assault shuttles]] in the Tribe's [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]]. He was stationed on [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]], where he received a message from [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], calling for reinforcements on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]]. Vhool traveled to Pydyr with [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]] and [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]]. There, they met with [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], who had been traveling with Vestara Khai.<ref name="Vortex" />

At Taalon's discretion, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] decided to temporarily spare the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], as Taalon wanted to learn from [[Abeloth]] what he was becoming&mdash;following his immersion in the [[Pool of Knowledge]], he had slowly begun to transform into the same kind of entity that she was. The Sith and Jedi flew to the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] village where Abeloth was hiding, fighting their way through illusions created by the [[White Current/Legends|White Current]]. Along the way, one of the Sith [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], the ''[[Obuuri]]'', was destroyed. Upon arriving in the village, Abeloth&mdash;in the body of the Fallanassi [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell]]&mdash;attacked the Sith with visions, first directed only at Gavar Khai, but then at Vhool and the entire Sith party, excepting Sarasu Taalon and Vestara Khai. To the Sith, it appeared as though they were beset by transluscent green phantoms that breathed vapor onto them, making them appear to have aged a dozen years, and stabbed them with tentacles, drawing upon their fear and becoming more opaque. The Sith scattered, fleeing from the village; some even jumped straight into the surrounding ocean to their deaths.<ref name="Vortex" />

While Vhool was beset by these visions, the Jedi [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|confronted]] Abeloth, again defeating her and forcing her to flee. As she left the planet, Vhool and the other Sith slowly began to return to their senses. Vhool quickly spied Vestara Khai and the Skywalkers walking toward the Jedi's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Jade Shadow]]''. He confronted them, told them to await Taalon's arrival before they could tend to their injuries in the medbay, and instructing Khai to prepare the vessel for departure. Khai started up the ''Jade Shadow'' while Vhool returned to the battle site to find Taalon. Suddenly, a wing of Jedi [[StealthX]]s arrived to come to the Skywalkers' aide, and Vhool discovered the truth that Khai had killed Taalon&mdash;unbeknownst to him, to prevent Taalon from becoming another being like Abeloth&mdash;and began to charge the ''Jade Shadow'' calling for her to be stopped. However, Khai opened fire on the Sith with the ''Jade Shadow''{{'s}} [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]], giving the Skywalkers time to make their way on board and escape.<ref name="Vortex" />
